newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-SUSPENSION RULES SA PINTO OUT OF LISBON DERBY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SUSPENSION RULES SA PINTO OUT OF LISBON DERBY.

text.p: Sporting Lisbon striker Ricardo Sa Pinto was suspended from playing in any domestic football on Friday following his attack last week on national coach Artur Jorge.
The Portugese League's disciplinary committee said in a statement they had suspended Sa Pinto immediately pending the final outcome of an enquiry into his behaviour.
Under league rules his eventual ban could range from one to six years.
Earlier this week he was suspended from being selected for the national team.
Sa Pinto attacked Jorge at a training session for the squad's World Cup qualifier against Northern Ireland last Saturday.
He said he had lashed out because he was angry with the coach for saying that he had excluded him from the national line-up because of disciplinary problems.
Jorge has said he will sue Sa Pinto, who apologised to the country and his club but did not mention Jorge by name, for assault.
The first match Sa Pinto will miss is Saturday's Lisbon derby between Sporting and arch-rivals Benfica.
